annotations.title: Ethos user by X (Twitter) handle or account id

description: Who is behind an X (Twitter) handle, and can they be trusted? The Ethos profile for a handle or numeric account id: display name, credibility score and status, every wallet address and social account linked to the same person, XP, influence factor, and how many positive, neutral and negative reviews and vouches they have received. Use it to vet an account before engaging, resolve a handle to its wallets, or enrich a mention with reputation. Free, no payment or key; the same answer as the free Ethos API. Example input: {"handle":"ethos_network"}. Example output: {"id":32936,"profileId":1,"displayName":"Ethos","username":"ethos_network","avatarUrl":"https://pbs.twimg.com/profile_images/2074951227599646720/85k3GJ-s.jpg","score":2441,"status":"ACTIVE","userkeys":["profileId:1","service:x.com:1234567890","address:0x1234…"],"xpTotal":4076702,"influenceFactor":276,"stats":{"review":{"received":{"positive":120,"neutral":3,"negative":2}},"vouch":{"received":{"count":40}}}}
